title: "As of" date, Location, Category, Vendor and part search combine with AND
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. In-stock parts exist with a known mix of categories and vendors, so a combined filter isolates a known subset.
steps:
1. Select a Category, then also a Vendor that only some of those category parts have.
2. Add a part search matching only one of the remaining parts.
3. Check the rows and the totals row after each step.
expected:
1. A part must satisfy EVERY active filter and the search to appear — the "as of" date, Location, Category, Vendor, and part search combine with AND.
2. The totals row matches the combined filtered set after each step.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per epic SV-8582, read on 17 August 2026, and the Inventory Value report specification version 10 (S6-R9), read on 17 August 2026.
Last checked against build v3.8-bd246fd on 8/18/2026.
